entry.title: Saving the Planet 2 - If I Were King

link.title: Saving the Planet 2 - If I Were King

entry.content:
Key Words: “Environment” “If “

Vocabularies: deforest , participate , announcement , industrialize , equipped , major , registrations

If I am the king - Joe’s original version

Today I am going to announce three crucial decisions as the king of my country. The arrangements all support the solutions to climate change, a crisis that still existed for over a century.

First, I order builders and construction workers to plant twenty to fifty trees after they deforest them. Larger quantities of tree-cutting bring larger amounts of reforestation and anybody who doesn’t participate will be fined over 2000 dollars. The second time, their tax will increase by multiples of two. The last time they will be sent to prison.

The second announcement is to industrialize more electric cars than brands without renewable energy. In 2025, half of all car factories will produce electronic vehicles. In the following two years, 90% of all cars in my country have to be powered by sustainable power. In another 12 months, every single vehicle must be driven by clean energy.

Finally, houses powered by renewable energy sources like solar power or have just equipped them will be paid $500 every month. If people’s vehicles are powered by sustainable energy, they will receive $200 per every 3 to 4 weeks.

After I have secured this pattern in my country, I will hold a climate change meeting with other Kings and prime ministers from all over the globe to discuss the major causes of climate change, its effects and develop a list of policies and registrations that every country will follow in the future.

I hope my plan will stop climate change from spreading across the world and the atmosphere which can cause significant changes in habitat and diet in wildlife. Everyone needs to participate in my rules and policies to protect our planet for future generations.

==================================================================== If I am the king - Dad’s version

Today, I am going to announce three crucial decisions as the king of this country, aiming to address our challenges of climate change, a crisis that has existed for over a century.  

First, I request builders and construction companies to plant twenty to fifty trees for every area of deforestation they cause. Anyone who doesn’t apply will face a 2000-dollar fine. Repeat offenders will be triple fined. For third-time offences, they will be imprisoned.

The following announcement is about renewable energy-powered cars. In 2025, electronic vehicles must be half of the new car production and sales. By 2027, we will achieve 90% of new car sales with sustainable power in the country. By the end of 2030, we will stop any traditional petrol and diesel car registration.

Finally, houses powered by renewable energy sources like solar power or those planning to install them will receive a $500 rebate from the government green energy program. Any vehicle powered by sustainable energy will have its owner eligible to claim a $200 subsidy annually.

In addition, I plan to initiate a yearly climate change conference, inviting other leaders worldwide to discuss the major strategies to address climate crisis and enforce a list of agreements and regulations for all countries to follow.

Above measures will be signed and take effect next month. They are part of our commitment to improve and protect our country and the planet for future generations.

============================================================================= If I am the king - ChatGPT version

Today, I am announcing three crucial decisions as the king of my country. These initiatives aim to address climate change, a crisis that has persisted for over a century.

First, I will mandate that builders and construction workers plant twenty to fifty trees for every tree they cut down. Larger deforestation projects will require proportionately larger reforestation efforts. Anyone failing to comply will face a fine of over $2,000. Repeat offenders will see their taxes double, and after a third offense, they will be imprisoned.

Second, I will prioritize the production of electric cars over traditional, non-renewable energy vehicles. By 2025, half of all car factories will produce electric vehicles. Within the next two years, 90% of all cars in the country must be powered by sustainable energy. Another year later, every single vehicle must run on clean energy.

Finally, households that install renewable energy sources, such as solar panels, will receive a monthly stipend of $500. Additionally, owners of vehicles powered by sustainable energy will receive $200 every month.

Once these measures are in place domestically, I will convene a global climate change summit with other kings and prime ministers to discuss the major causes and effects of climate change. We will develop a comprehensive list of policies and regulations for all countries to follow.

entry.title: Saving Our Planet 1: Climate Change
entry.content:
Key Words: “Environment” “Persuasive “

Vocabularies: century , atmosphere , renewable , deforestation , generations , carbon dioxide , temperature

Joe original version

Did you know that the Earth’s temperature has been increasing for over a century? That is a crisis, a challenge of planet-saving. In this essay, I will explain the causes of climate change, its effects, and what we can do to help.

One of the main causes of climate change is burning fossil, like coal, oil and gas; cars and factories all burn fossil fuels, releasing carbon dioxide, which traps heat in the atmosphere, making the planet warmer.

Climate change affects the Earth in many ways. For example, the heat of the rising temperature melts ice from the Arctic and Antarctica, making the planet warmer; Penguins, polar bears, and seals will lose their habitat and diet, and the rising sea level will cause floods.

Despite the terrible effects of climate crisis, there are also many solutions to solve this problem. Little by little. We can start by using renewable energy like solar power instead of burning fossil fuels, plant more trees to stop deforestation, and many other ways together we can stop climate change starting with communities, then countries, and eventually the whole world.

Climate change is caused by burning fossil fuels, it caused the ice to melt which leads to floods, but we can stop it by using renewable energy and planting more trees. It is important for all of us to work together and protect the planet for future generations.

=====================================================

Dad revised version

Did you know Earth’s temperature has increased for over a century? Research from NASA indicates that the average Earth’s surface temperature has risen 1.8 degrees over the past 30 years. People call this “climate crisis” a challenge of planet-saving. In this essay, I will explain the major causes of climate change and how it affects human life, then explore the possible solutions and approaches to improve such a problem to restore and bring sustainability for future generations.

Human activities such as “burning fossil fuels,” “deforestation,” and “industrialization” can be the main causes of climate change.

Coal, oil, and gas have become the most important energy sources supporting transportation and construction in the past few decades. Every day, cars and factories consume fossil fuels, releasing carbon dioxide that traps heat in the atmosphere, making the planet warmer globally.

Moreover, heat increases temperature levels, which impacts all living things in ecosystems; recent research shows that the ice in the Arctic and Antarctica has reduced significantly compared to 200 years ago, and rising sea levels bring significant threats to all coastal cities with potential floods.

Wild animals such as penguins, polar bears, and seals and their habitat and diet have been permanently changed/impacted. Scientists forecast that some species living in the North Pole will be distinct in a few years. Fishes and coral reefs under the sea are also facing challenges in finding a suitable environment in which to live.

In addition, all modern civilization heavily relies on oil and coal; sustainable solutions are necessary for future generations living on this beautiful planet to avoid limited resources and a terrible environment.

Despite the urgent situation and challenges of our planet/environment, many countries, scientists, and universities continuously invent and apply possible new energy solutions. For examples, Japan recently published policies to force half of the new car registrations to only electric vehicles. The Australian government rewards new homes that install solar power as renewable energy. China has planted 1 million trees in the northern region in the past ten years to stop deforestation. With the efforts of each country, community, and individual, people are constantly making a difference in stopping climate change.

In conclusion, climate change has been a major issue for centuries, and it will be a disaster if no action is taken worldwide; it is time to work together and protect the planet for future generations.

In this essay, I will explain the major causes of climate change, how it affects human life, and explore possible solutions to restore sustainability for future generations.

  • Causes of Climate Change

Human activities such as burning fossil fuels, deforestation, and industrialization are the main causes of climate change. =============================================

ChatGPT 100 point version

  • Climate Change: Causes, Effects, and Solutions

Climate change is one of the most pressing issues of our time. It refers to significant changes in global temperatures and weather patterns over time. While climate change is a natural phenomenon, scientific evidence shows that human activities have accelerated its pace, leading to unprecedented environmental challenges. This essay explores the primary causes of climate change, its profound effects on human life and ecosystems, and the urgent solutions needed to mitigate its impact.

  • Causes of Climate Change

The main causes of climate change are human activities, particularly the burning of fossil fuels, deforestation, and various industrial processes.

Burning Fossil Fuels: Fossil fuels such as coal, oil, and natural gas have been the cornerstone of global energy production for decades. When burned, these fuels release significant amounts of carbon dioxide (CO2) and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. These gases trap heat from the sun, creating a “greenhouse effect” that warms the planet. For instance, automobiles, airplanes, and power plants all rely heavily on fossil fuels, contributing to the majority of CO2 emissions.

Deforestation: Forests act as carbon sinks, absorbing CO2 from the atmosphere. However, widespread deforestation for agriculture, logging, and urban development has drastically reduced the number of trees available to absorb CO2. This not only releases the carbon stored in trees but also diminishes the Earth’s capacity to absorb future emissions. The Amazon rainforest, often called the “lungs of the Earth,” has seen significant deforestation, leading to increased atmospheric CO2 levels.

Industrial Processes: Various industrial activities, such as cement production, chemical manufacturing, and mining, release a substantial amount of greenhouse gases. For example, cement production alone is responsible for about 8% of global CO2 emissions. These industries also emit other potent greenhouse gases like methane (CH4) and nitrous oxide (N2O), which have a higher global warming potential than CO2.

  • Effects of Climate Change

The impacts of climate change are far-reaching and affect various aspects of life on Earth.

Rising Temperatures: Global temperatures have been steadily increasing, leading to more frequent and severe heatwaves. This not only affects human health but also puts stress on natural ecosystems. For instance, higher temperatures can lead to the bleaching of coral reefs, which are vital marine habitats.

Melting Ice Caps and Rising Sea Levels: The polar ice caps and glaciers are melting at an alarming rate, contributing to rising sea levels. This poses a significant threat to coastal communities, as higher sea levels can lead to more severe flooding and erosion. Cities like Miami and New York are already experiencing the early effects of rising sea levels.

Extreme Weather Events: Climate change has been linked to an increase in the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events such as hurricanes, droughts, and wildfires. These events can cause widespread destruction, displacing communities and leading to loss of life and property. For example, recent hurricanes in the Atlantic have been more powerful and destructive, partly due to warmer ocean temperatures.

Impact on Biodiversity: Many species are struggling to adapt to the rapidly changing climate, leading to shifts in distribution and, in some cases, extinction. Polar bears, for example, are losing their natural habitat as Arctic ice melts. Similarly, changes in temperature and precipitation patterns are affecting agricultural yields, threatening food security for millions of people.

  • Solutions to Climate Change

Addressing climate change requires a multifaceted approach involving governments, businesses, and individuals.

Transition to Renewable Energy: Shifting from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and hydroelectric power is crucial. These sources produce little to no greenhouse gases and can significantly reduce our carbon footprint. Countries like Germany and Denmark have made substantial progress in integrating renewable energy into their power grids.

Reforestation and Afforestation: Planting trees and restoring forests can help absorb CO2 from the atmosphere. Initiatives like the Great Green Wall in Africa aim to plant millions of trees to combat desertification and climate change. Additionally, protecting existing forests, particularly tropical rainforests, is essential for maintaining the Earth’s carbon balance.

Energy Efficiency: Improving energy efficiency in buildings, transportation, and industry can reduce overall energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. Simple measures such as better insulation, energy-efficient appliances, and public transportation systems can make a significant difference.

Policy and Regulation: Governments must implement and enforce policies that limit greenhouse gas emissions. The Paris Agreement, for example, is a global pact aimed at reducing emissions and limiting global warming to well below 2 degrees Celsius. Carbon pricing, through taxes or cap-and-trade systems, can also provide economic incentives for reducing emissions.

Public Awareness and Education: Raising awareness about climate change and its impacts is vital for encouraging action at all levels of society. Educational programs, media campaigns, and community initiatives can help people understand the importance of reducing their carbon footprint and adopting sustainable practices.

Technological Innovation: Investing in research and development of new technologies can provide innovative solutions to combat climate change. Advances in battery storage, carbon capture and storage (CCS), and sustainable agriculture practices hold promise for a more sustainable future.

  • Conclusion

Climate change is a complex and urgent issue that requires immediate and sustained action. By understanding its causes, recognizing its profound effects, and implementing comprehensive solutions, we can work together to mitigate its impact and protect our planet for future generations. It is a collective responsibility that demands the cooperation of governments, businesses, and individuals worldwide to ensure a sustainable and resilient future.

entry.title: The Speech
entry.content:
Key Words: “Narrative” “Fables” “Speech”

Vocabularies: candidates , passionate , opportunity , interested , various , draft , revised , secure

The Speech

My name is Joe, and I am an eight-year-old boy who dreams of becoming an inspiring writer.

Recently, my school announced a speech competition on the topic of multiculturalism. Each class will have three candidates competing in the Hall, and two final winners will represent the school.

When I heard about the competition, I felt super excited because I have lots of ideas and thoughts to share. I believed this was a golden opportunity to present my unique opinions on stage.

Some students in my class are also passionate about this event, while others are not as interested. My main competitor, Ronald, is one of the most determined kids I know. He plays various sports, such as handball, soccer, and basketball, and his knowledge and skills in Math and English are impressive. During class, he often provides surprising answers to challenging questions.

After school, I quickly created my first draft of the speech about peace and multiculturalism. It was short, with only three paragraphs. The next day, I presented my speech in front of the class, just like everyone else. I felt okay because I completed the speech from memory, while others used palm cards. Ronald’s speech about racism caught my attention; his humor and connection with the audience were terrific, not to mention his brilliant opinions.

I realized I needed a better version to be selected, so I decided to ask my Dad for help. My Dad is a software developer, busy coding all day long. However, he always finds time to offer me advice and support whenever he can.

When he heard my speech, he suggested adding examples and explanations about peace, war, and multiculturalism to make it more logical and rich. Though he was too busy that day, he promised to help me practice the speech during the weekend when he was free.

The next day in class, I couldn’t wait and gave another speech with some improvements. Ronald’s second performance was even better; he took the teacher’s feedback with more eye contact and expression.

Watching his speech made me feel jealous.

That night, I went to my Dad, and we revised my speech by adding more layers of conflicts and my own experiences with multiculturalism. I practiced in front of a camera to improve my confidence and body language. After that, I felt sure I would finally beat Ronald and secure a place in the Hall.

Unfortunately, no one got chance to speech again until the following week, three winners were announced in our class. Ronald was listed, but I was not.

I felt devastated all day.

After dinner, my Dad noticed and said calmly, “You know, sometimes losing doesn’t mean failure. As long as you are willing to go the extra mile, I am sure you will win another speech competition in the future.”

entry.title: Be Our Guest from Beauty and the Beast 1991

link.title: Be Our Guest from Beauty and the Beast 1991

entry.content:
Key Words: “Animation Movie” “Song”

Vocabularies: animated , released , exchanges , prisoner , masterpiece , comparable , original

Be Our Guest

“Be Our Guest” is a song from the Disney animated movie “Beauty and the Beast,” released in 1991.

It occurs in the first half of the movie shortly after Belle exchanges places with her father as the Beast’s prisoner. After refusing to join the Beast for dinner, Belle explores the kitchen, where she is greeted by the enchanted servants: Mrs. Potts, Cogsworth, and Lumière.

The feast starts with bowls jumping onto the dinner table, while Lumière lights a matchstick. Soon, everyone is dancing and singing “Be Our Guest.” Belle tastes each dish presented, each one better than the last, as the plates and spoons form into the Eiffel Tower, magically indicating the story’s French setting.

I believe this is one of the most creatively animated songs I’ve ever seen. Although the technology in 1991 may not have been as advanced as it is now, its hand-drawn animation was top-level back then. Perhaps “Under the Sea” from “The Little Mermaid” (1989) is comparable, as it magically combines various musical instruments into the song, amaze me same as the chopstick fighting scene from “Kung Fu Panda” (2008).

My favorite part is when Cogsworth tries to escape the scene with a funny smile as Lumière sings, “Life is so unnerving for a servant who’s not serving.”

Comparing the 1991 version of “Be Our Guest” with the live-action version from 2017, I prefer the voice and music in the latter, but the dancing and characters in the original. The song could be improved with deeper lyrics or additional layers of music to enhance its richness.

Overall, I believe “Be Our Guest” is a sensational masterpiece by Walt Disney that will stay with me for quite some time.

entry.title: A Letter to Matilda
entry.content:
Key Words: “Letter”

Vocabularies: fascinating , inspired , adaptation , original , Surprisingly , featuring , determination

Dear Matilda,

I hope this letter reaches you well in the world of literature.

Did you know that you and your fascinating adventure have inspired generations? I’ve read the book “Matilda” from Roald Dahl many times and watched two movies made in 1996 and 2022 based on your original story, featuring characters like Miss Honey, Miss Trunchbull, and many others.

Speaking about Miss Honey, I had a teacher named Miss Song who was always caring for her students. Luckily, my school is nothing like the one you went to. We have lots of fun activities and multicultural subjects here. Unlike your parents, the Wormwoods, my parents love me more than anything and support my dream of becoming a writer in the future. I’m sorry if that makes you jealous.

Also, I love reading books, maybe not as much as you do. My top three favorite authors are Roald Dahl, David Williams, and E.B. White. They’ve written many exciting stories I’m sure you would enjoy.

Surprisingly, people in Australia call their national women’s soccer team the “Matildas,” because of those female athletes with great determination and bravery, just like you.

So, you’ve encouraged both adults and children to become more independent and stand up for what’s right. People now recognize you and your story as a timeless classic. I will tell my little sister and my kids about you someday, wish they can be as intelligent, independent and a bookworm same as you. I hope you could come and visit my city to explore the countless new books in the library. I look forward to seeing you!

With admiration and gratitude,

Joe

11/05/2024

entry.title: The Incredibles (2004) - Movie Review
entry.content:
Key Words: “MovieReview” “Superhero” “Family”

Vocabularies: forcefield , lack , sued , terminated , stunning , mixture , ambition

The Incredibles review

Mr. Incredible (Bob) was the world’s greatest superhero because of his strength that protected the city from danger.

His biggest fan was a boy named Buddy, but the boy was denied to become Bob’s sidekick. After a while, Bob married Elastic Girl, another superhero, and then got three children – Dash, the little boy with lightning speed, a teenager girl with the ability to turn invisible and create forcefield, and a baby, Jack Jack.

Unfortunately, as people sued superheroes, the Incredible family had to hide their abilities. Until Mr Incredible started to work secretly for an agency on an island, which made him a lot happier than before.

However, Bob soon discovered that he was working for Buddy who had terminated many superheroes to upgrade his AI learning robot so he can become the only superhero. Mr. Incredible tried to stop but got trapped.

In the meantime, the superhero’s wife found out Bob’s secret job and decided to rescue him. On the island, the incredible family fought together against Buddy’s evil plan and finally defeated the robot to save the city.

I think this is the best superhero movie because of the cool fighting scenes, how each character has their own ability and challanges to overcome. It stands out from other superhero movies by its stunning animation, wonderful storytelling, a mixture of family, teamwork and superhero all in one.

I also love the scene when the incredible family fought against the guards in flying saucers. Everyone in the family eventually finds themselves, like Mr. Incredible learnt teamwork instead of fighting alone. The filmmaker put in a lot of effort and details to show his ambition to deliver an unique superhero-type animation movie.

Overall I will rate this movie 8.2 out of 10.

entry.title: Matilda (1996) vs Matilda the Musical (2022)
entry.content:
Key Words: “MovieReview” “Comparison”

Vocabularies: pros and cons , posh , independent , intelligence

Matilda Movie Comparision 1996 vs 2022:

Both Matilda movies have different pros and cons.

In Matilda the Musical (2022) there were songs with rhymes and fantastic dancing like another recent movie “Wonka”, it added adaptation like the physical education scenes, removed Matilda’s brother Micheal, and provided more detailed descriptions of Miss Honey’s story. The cons are that Matilda is a bit childish and posh to me by saying ‘That’s not right’ or ‘Isn’t it well kind of wrong’ and acts more like a hero who saved the school. The movie also changed about 30% of the story from the original book written by Roald Daul.

In the old version of Matilda on 1996, however, the characters performed better, added parts like Matilda sneaking into the Trunchbull’s house to collect Lisy doll and two pieces of chocolate, together with the FBI watching the Wormwood’s house part. I especially loved the incredible pancake scene. The negative part of this version can be that Matilda is more independent and mature but is too quiet and some scenes were too slow.

Overall, the two movies all share the same morals and messages - the power of kindness, intelligence and standing up to bullies. I think both movies are on the same level because of Matilda the Musical (2022)’s songs and Matilda (1996)’s lovely actors and performance. They all deserve a rating of 7.0 out of 10.0.

entry.title: Robot Dreams - Movie Review
entry.content:
Key Words: “MovieReview” “Robot” ” Animation”

Vocabularies: inseparable , companion , reunite , struggled , relationship , emotional , loss , separated

Robot Dreams review:

A dog lived alone in New York city, dreaming about friends. Everything changed when he bought a robot companion from an advertisement. The two quickly became inseparable friends.

One day, robot was broken at the ocean beach, and the dog tried everyway but still had to leave his friend there until the beach reopens next year.

The robot had 3 dreams to be reunited with the dog, unfortunately he was taken and smashed in the scrapyard. In the meantime, the dog struggled to make new friends and eventually bought another yellow robot.

Luckily, the robot was picked and repaired by a raccoon, and they developed new relationship soon.

One afternoon, the robot spotted dog again, he decided to keep all their good memory and move on to each other’s new life.

I love this story’s dialogue-free, emotional scenes and music, which made me cry. It reminded me another movie “Big hero 6”, a robot companion Baymax. I really like the song “Semptember” from this movie.

“Robot Dreams” talks about friendship, love and loss, it will inspire anyone who had the same experience from the story and encourage people to grow up and move on when they get separated.

I think robot dreams is one of my favorite movie, I will rate it 7.8/10.

entry.title: Fantastic Mr.Fox - Book Review
entry.content:
Key Words: “BookReview” “Roald Dahl” ” Adventure and Family”

Vocabularies: moral , concepts , victory , Ultimately , sumptuous , thrilling , storytelling , challenging

Joe’s original version:

Fantastic Mr Fox by Roald Dahl is a brilliant short novel because of its escalating tension, excitement and moral concepts. For example, when Mr. Fox brought food back, he gave it to his wife instead of himself. Here is how the story unfolds:

Mr. Fox and his family lived underground near the farms of three mean farmers Boggis and Bunce and Bean. Each day, Mr fox would steal food from them and bring them back for his children and wife, Mrs Fox.

One day, the farmers decided they are going to put an end to it. They used their shotguns to shoot Mr. Fox’s tail off, but he escaped just in time. However the three farmers won’t give up. They started to dig the household out with shovels and tractors, while the foxes competed with their bare hands.

With some commands, Mr Fox, Mrs. Fox, and the four small children, dug tunnels to each of the farmers storehouses while they waited in the rain for the husband to come out.

In the end, the foxes and their friends celebrated their victory through a great feast, Mr. Fox even offered to provide food through the tunnel for everyone living underground.

I learn how to be a good husband when I grow up, and what it takes to be fantastic, and it reminded me of the movie “Home Alone” because the boy faced the similar situation by outsmarting the robbers, I love “Fantastic Mr fox”, memorable characters, description, and what to do in danger.

Dad revised version:

“Fantastic Mr. Fox” by Roald Dahl is an amazing short story. Let me tell you all about it:

Mr. Fox and his family lived underground near the farms of three mean owners: Boggis, Bunce, and Bean. Every day, Mr. Fox would cleverly sneak into the farms to bring food back to his family safely.

But one day, the farmers decided they had enough. They wanted to stop Mr. Fox once and for all! They waited in ambush but only shot off a tail as Mr. Fox outsmarted them and escaped.

The farmers didn’t give up, though. They started digging to catch Mr. Fox and his family. They used big tractors to try and destroy the hill where the foxes lived. In addtion, they placed guards at every possible exit around the whole area to trap and starve the fox family!

But Mr. Fox was clever and brave. He and his children, along with their animal friends, dug tunnels to each of the farmers’ storehouses quietly. They stole food without all farmers ever knowing!

In the end, the foxes celebrated their victory with a big feast toghther all the other underground animals. Meanwhile, the farmers were left waiting outside in the rain, still trying to catch them.

This book brings not only thrilling storytelling and illustration but also uses Mr fox as a perfect example to show kids how to think and act cleverly and bravely with determination in urgent or challenging situations, and how to take responsibility and provide for family and community. I remember another movie “Home Alone,” where a little boy also outwits two adult bad guys with his cleverness, courage and bravery. I love “Fantastic Mr. Fox” because it has great characters, easy-to-understand descriptions, and teaches us valuable lessons about being smart and brave when things get tough.

entry.title: The Lorax - Book Review
entry.content:
Key Words: “BookReview” “Environment” “Timeless Classic”

Vocabularies: leftover , sustainability , ecosystem , greenhouse gases , climate change , mitigation , carbon dioxide , pollution

Joe’s original version:

“The Lorax” by Dr. Seuss, is an educational story, with memorable rhymes and illustrations. It tells the readers to respect the nature environment and not be like the greedy Once-ler, it uses a present-past-future structure.

I like Dr. Seuss’s made-up words in the book, like “thneed” and “wisper-ma-phone”, my dad told me the book was published even before he was born, which made me very shocked about the author’s vision. After reading the book I felt regret about cutting a tree in my front yard last year.

The story starts when a boy asked the Once-ler to tell him about how the Lorax was lifted away. It turned out that back in the time when the environment was still green, a greedy Once-ler discovered the Trufulla forest and started chopping down them to make a “Thneed” to make money. Then a creature called the Lorax who speaks for the trees and animals scolded the greedy businessman. However, the Onceler ignored the warning and continued to grow his business by using tools and building factories to produce more thneeds and deliver everywhere to get rich. The Lorax once again appeared to tell him that all the animals’ diet and habitat were being destroyed but Onceler refused to listen until the last tree was chopped.

At the end of the story, the guilty Once-ler offered the very last Trufulla seed to the boy and hoped he will restore the balance of nature.

Dad revised version:

“The Lorax” by Dr. Seuss is an imaginative tale filled with delightful rhymes and wonderful illustrations. It sends a crucial message about respecting the environment and avoiding the problems and issues of greed and industrialization, presented through a clever structure that spans past, present, and future.

I particularly enjoy Dr. Seuss’s creative wordplay in the book, such as “thneed” and “wisper-ma-phone.” Learning that the book was published even before my dad was born amazed me, showing the author’s remarkable foresight. Reading “The Lorax” made me reflect on my own actions, like regretting cutting down a tree in my front yard last year. It also reminds me another famous Disney Movie “Wall-E” which describes similar picture about our planet full of junk and people desperately seeking for the last green plant to restore earth their planet home.

“The Lorax” begins with a curious boy seeking to understand how the Lorax disappeared. We journey back to a time when the world was lush and green, only to meet the greedy Once-ler who stumbled upon the Truffula forest. Ignoring the warnings of the Lorax, a creature who speaks for the trees, the Once-ler damaged the forest to manufacture “Thneeds” for profit. Despite the Lorax’s pleas to preserve nature, the Once-ler’s greed drives him to expand his business, leading to the devastation of the animals’ habitats and food sources.

In the conclusion, the regretful Once-ler hands over the last Truffula seed to the boy, urging him to restore the balance of nature.

“The Lorax” is not only a fascinating story but also a powerful reminder of the importance of environmental protection and sustainability. Its timeless message reflects deeply, encouraging young and any other age readers to consider the impact of their needs and actions on the world they heavily rely on.
